list.name: sensor_topic
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "sensor_data", tag: "topic", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "temperature", start: -10m)

targets.query: from(bucket: "sensor_data") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature") |> last() |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> mean()
from(bucket: "sensor_data") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity") |> last() |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> mean()

from(bucket: "sensor_data") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic == "${sensor_topic}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature") |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor_data") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic == "${sensor_topic}/config") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_offset") |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor_data") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic == "${sensor_topic}/config") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "hum_offset") |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor_data") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic == "${sensor_topic}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity") |> last()
